crossRefs.note: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus, who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be…
But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and…
They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

translations.web: They went out from there, and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it.
translations.bsb: Going on from there, they passed through Galilee. But Jesus did not want anyone to know,
translations.kjv: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know
translations.asv: And they went forth from thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
